text.cop: Ⲁ̀ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲣⲛⲓϣϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ:
text.cop_lat: A pekran ernishti khen etkhora enkeemi:
text.en: Your name is great in the land of Egypt,

section.en: Your name is so great (Apekran), Ⲁⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.cop: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...).
text.cop_lat: o pimakarios pi-agios ettaieeout khen ni-agios teerou peniot ethowab abba (...).
text.en: O blessed saint, who is honored among all saints, out holy father, Abba (…).
text.ar: أيها الطوباوي القديس المكرم في جميع القديسين أبونا الطاهر (...).

text.en: Hail to your tomb full of blessing,

text.cop: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲃⲉⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲛⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ.
text.cop_lat: shere peksoma ethowab fee-etafvevi nan evol enkheetf enje outalcho enshoni niven.
text.en: hail to your holy body which gives cure to all sicknesses.
text.ar: السلام لجسدك المقدس الذي نبع لنا منه شفاء لكل الأمراض.

text.en: that He may forgive us our sins,
I am the poor and wretched.

text.cop: ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡⲁϩⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲉⲣⲫ̀ⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ:
text.cop_lat: afkim e-ekhree epaheet enje pekerefmevi ettaieeout:
text.en: your honored commemoration has touched my heart,

section.en: Today this Virgin (A tai-parthenos), Ⲁ̀ Ⲧⲁⲓⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: her clothing is woven with gold,

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲕⲓⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: A David kim empishorp enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: David moved the first string of his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: داود حرك الوتر الأول من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
text.cop_lat: je asohi erats enje tiouro saouinam emmok Epouro.
text.en: "At Your right hand stands the Queen O King." (Ps. 45:9)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ (ⲃ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahesnav (esnav) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the second string from his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر الثاني من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲧⲁϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲣⲉⲕ ⲡⲉⲙⲁϣϫ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓ ⲡ̀ⲱⲃϣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲓⲱⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je sotem tasheri anav rek pemashg ari epovsh empelaos nem epee teerf ente peiot.
text.en: "Listen O daughter consider and incline your ear. Forget your own people also and your father's house." (Ps. 45:10)
text.ar: "إسمعي يا إبنتي وأُنظري وأميلي أذنِكِ وإنسي شعبِك وبيت أبيكِ." (مز ٤٥ : ١٠)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϣⲟⲙⲧ (ⲅ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahshomt (shomt) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the third string from his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر الثالث من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲥⲉⲃⲱⲛ ⲉⲥϫⲟⲗϩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛϣ̀ⲧⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ.
text.cop_lat: je epoou teerf enetsheri emepouro enesevon esgolh khen haneshtati enieb ennoub.
text.en: "The royal daughter is all glorious within her clothing is woven with gold." (Ps. 45:13)
text.ar: "كل مجد إبنة الملك من الداخل مشتملة بأطراف موشاة بالذهب." (مز ٤٥ : ١٣)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ (ⲇ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimaheftoou (eftou) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the fourth string from his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر الرابع من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ ⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ϩⲓⲫⲁϩⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: je eve ini ekhoun empiouro enhanparthenos hifahou emmos.
text.en: "Virgins shall enter to the King after her."(Ps. 45:14)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲉⲧⲓⲟⲟⲩ (ⲉ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahetioou (etiou) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the fifth string from his harp proclaiming and saying, "Great is our Lord,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر الخامس من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲡⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
text.cop_lat: je ounishti pe Epshois efesmaroout emasho khen ethvaki empennoti hijen peftoou ethowab.
text.en: and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in His holy mountain." (Ps. 48:1)
text.ar: "عظيم هو الرب ومسبح جداً في مدينة إلهنا على جبله المقدس." (مز ٤٨ : ١)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲥⲟⲟⲩ (ⲋ) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahsoou (soou) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the sixth string from his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر السادس من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲧⲉⲛϩ ⲛ̀ϭ̀ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲟϣϫ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲉⲙⲟϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲧⲟⲩⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲃ.
text.cop_lat: je hantenh enechrompi evoshg enieb enhat o-woh neskemoti khen o-otowet ente ounoub.
text.en: "The wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold." (Ps. 68:13)
text.ar: "أجنحة حمامة موشاة بفضة ومنكباها بصفرة الذهب." (مز ٦٨ : ١٣)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϣⲁϣϥ (ⲍ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahshashf (shashf) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: And he moved the seventh string from his harp crying out and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر السابع من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲕⲉⲛⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϭⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲕⲉⲛⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je pitoou ente Efnoti pitoou etkeni-oout pitoou etchees pitoou etkeni-oout.
text.en: "The mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan. A mountain of many peaks is the mountain of Bashan. (Ps. 68:15)
text.ar: "جبل الله الجبل الدسم، الجبل المجبن، الجبل الدسم." (مز ٦٨ : ١٥)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϣ̀ⲙⲏⲛ (ⲏ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimaheshmeen (eshmeen) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the eighth string from his harp crying out and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر الثامن من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲛⲉϥⲥⲉⲛϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲙⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ.
text.cop_lat: je nefsenti khen nitoou ethowab a Epshois mei ennipilee ente Sion.
text.en: "His foundation is in the holy mountains. The Lord loves the gates of Zion." (Ps. 87:1, 2)
text.ar: "أساساته في الجبال المقدسة، أحب الرب أبواب صهيون." (مز ٨٧ : ١ ، ٢)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲯⲓⲧ (ⲑ̅) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahpsit (psit) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the ninth string from his harp proclaiming and saying,
text.ar: وحرك الوتر التاسع من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲩⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ.
text.cop_lat: je avsaji ethveeti enhanehveeoui evtaieeout tivaki ente Efnoti.
text.en: "Glorious things are spoken of you O city of God." (Ps. 87:3)
text.ar: "تكلموا من أجلك بأعمال كريمة يا مدينة الله." (مز ٨٧ : ٣)

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧ (ⲓ̅ ) ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Afkim epimahmeet (meet ) enkap ente tefkithara efosh evol efgo emmos:
text.en: He moved the tenth string from his harp proclaiming and saying, "For the Lord has chosen Zion.
text.ar: وحرك الوتر العاشر من قيثارته صارخاً قائلاً:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ.
text.cop_lat: je a Epshois sotp ension afsotp emmos eouma enshopi naf.
text.en: He has desired it for His habitation." (Ps. 132:13)

section.en: Rejoice O Theotokos (Rashi Ne), Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ Ϯⲑⲉⲟⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: Mary the mother of Jesus Christ.
text.ar: والدة الاله مريم ام يسوع المسيح.

text.en: we rejoice, O mother of the King.
Rejoice to the God, our helper,
rejoice to the God of Jacob.
for this my tongue also praises.
and the rejoicing are due to your name.

section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: for You have come and saved us.

text.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ ̀ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲱⲓⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏ̀ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (Ϣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲇⲁ) ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲁⲣⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Hiten ni-evshee ente penoit ettai-eeout enarshee-erevs papa abba (Shenouda) nem peniot enepiskopos abba (...) Epshois Ari-ehmot nan mpiko evol ente nennovi.
text.en: Through the prayers: of our honored father: the high priest Papa Abba (Shenouda) and our father the bishop Abba (...) :O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
text.ar: بصلوات أبينا المكرم رئيس الكهنة البابا الانبا (شنوده) وأبينا الاسقف الانبا (...). يا رب أنعم لنا بمغفرة خطايانا.

text.en: (This hymn is a continuation of ek-esmaroot. It starts with part of the last word of ek-esmaroot.) emm(on).
text.ar: (هذا اللحن يكون تكملة للحن إكيسماروؤت). لذلك يبدأ بكلمة إممون.

section.en: Rejoice O Mother of God (O-On Shere), (ⲟⲛ) Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲉ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: to You O God is due praise in Zion,
text.ar: يا الله يجب لك التسبيح فى صهيون،

text.en: and the vows will be fulfilled to You in Jerusalem;

text.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲱⲙⲉⲛⲏ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ⲟ̀ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: Shere ke kharitomenee Maria o Kirios metasou:
text.en: Rejoice O you full of grace, Mary, the Lord is with you;
text.ar: إفرحي يا ممتلئة نعمة يا مريم الرب معكِ،

text.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲉ Ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲉ ⲟ̀ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲃⲟⲩ ⲥⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲧⲟⲩ ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲓⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲟⲛ Ⲑⲉⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Shere The-otoke Parthene o epresvevou se ipertou kosmou ton soteeria ke ton Theon eemon:
text.en: Rejoice O Theotokos, the Virgin, the intercessor of the world to the Savior our God;
text.ar: إفرحي يا والدة الإله العذراء يا شفيعة في العالم عند المخلص إلهنا،

text.cop: Ⲙⲏⲧⲉⲣ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲛⲁ ⲡⲓⲣⲟⲅⲁⲙⲏ.
text.cop_lat: Meeter tou Emmanoweel tees pina piroghamee.
text.en: the Mother of Emmanuel, who is not provoked with marriage.
text.ar: والدة عمانوئيل يا غير مجربة بزواج.

text.en: Rejoice O you who is of the rank of the angels;

text.cop: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲁ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲟⲛ Ⲑⲉⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: shere thee-eprostasia eemon tou Patri ke ton Theon eemon:
text.en: Rejoice O our intercessor before our God the Father;
text.ar: إفرحي يا شفيعتنا عند الآب إلهنا،

section.en: The Lord is with you (O kirios), Ⲟ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: of glory with the Holy Spirit.
who speaks in the heavenly truth
Joy is with the Father at all time,

section.en: Seven times everyday (Shashf Ensop), Ϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲛⲓ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: I will praise Your Holy Name,
saying Hail to you O Mary,
the salvation of our father Adam, Hail...
the mother of the Refuge, Hail...
Hail... the joy of the righteous Abel, Hail...
Hail... the grace of Abraham, Hail...
the redemption of Saint Isaac, Hail...
Hail... the rejoicing of Jacob, Hail...
Hail... the preaching of Moses, Hail...
the Mother of the Master, Hail...
Hail... the steadfastness of Job the Righteous, Hail...
the Mother of the Beloved, Hail...
Hail... the friend of Solomon, Hail...
Hail... the knowledge of Ezekiel, Hail...
Hail... the Mother of God, Hail...
the Mother of Jesus Christ, Hail...
text.ar: والدة الإله: السلام ... أم يسوع المسيح:

text.en: the Mother of the Son of God.
to the Son of the Highest,
keep the gates of the Church,
the Word without seed of man,

text.ar: تعالوا يا جميع الشعوب لننظر الي رئيس

section.en: Come all you nations (Zefte Pentees), Ⲇⲉⲩⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲥ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.ar: يا جميع الشعوب لننظر إلي رئيس الملائكة قائلين:

text.en: with the Word of the Father,
hail to the wise, the full of grace,
you to whom the Holy Spirit came,

text.ar: يا أم الختن العريس الله مجدك

text.cop: ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲇⲟⲍⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲕⲉ ⲟ̀ Ⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲥⲁⲣⲕⲟⲕⲓ ⲇⲓⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ:
text.cop_lat: the-othozaste ke o Loghos sarkoki thinamis:
text.en: took flesh and was born from you,
with the hosts of angels proclaim:
hail to the mother of our Savior,
O you who gave birth to God,

text.ar: ولدت الله الكلمة إفرحي ايتها العذراء الطاهرة إفرحي

text.en: hail to the Mother of Christ,
rejoice O Mother of our Savior,
rejoice O Mother of the Light of the world.
Rejoice O you the one that is honored,
by the choir of the angels,
which your heart rejoices in, O Mary,
you have found grace, the Lord is with you.

section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: O Lady of us all the Mother of God,
Saint Mary the Mother of Jesus Christ,
text.ar: والدة الاله مريم ام يسوع المسيح

text.en: that He may forgive us our sins.

section.en: Ep-ooro - O King of peace, Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: with the glory of His Father,

text.ar: نسجد لك ايها المسيح مع ابيك الصالح

text.en: for You have (risen) and saved us.

section.en: Many are all your wonders (Sena Etsho), Ⲥⲉⲛⲁ ⲧ̀ϣⲟ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: O the pride of all the virgins,
The Lord our Lord how wonderful,
is Your name upon all the earth.
to Your mother the high crown.
This is the image of the Theotokos,

section.en: This is the image (Fai Pep-lemen), Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲗⲩⲙⲉⲛ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: Mary the mother of the Son of God.
raised her up to His Kingdom.
which an eye has not seen.
according to the words of the wise.
You are the salvation of Adam,
and all his children with him.
Mary the rejoicing of the angels,
Mary the pride of the apostles.
You are the Mother of Light,

section.en: You are the Mother of Light (Entho Ethmav), Ⲛⲑⲟ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: After you gave birth to Him,
and the pleasure of His Father,
and made a place of rest,
of the Mother of God Saint Mary,
Come let us worship the Holy Trinity,

section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.en: Hail to you O Mary the beautiful dove,

text.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠⲛ̅ⲁ̅
text.cop_lat: Khen efran emefiot nem Epsheeri nem pi-epnevma
text.en: In the name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit,

section.en: In the name (Khen Efran), Ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.cop: Ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: Aksia aksia aksia ti-agi-a Mari-a tiparthenos.
text.en: Worthy, worthy, worthy, St. Mary the Virgin.
text.ar: مستحقة مستحقة مستحقة القديسة مريم العذراء.

text.en: Worthy, worthy, worthy (saint of the church).
Worthy, worthy, worthy (saint of the tamgeed).

text.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲓⲟ (...) ⲁⲝⲓⲟⲥ ⲁⲝⲓⲟⲥ ⲁⲝⲓⲟⲥ (...).
text.cop_lat: Marenthoouti o pilaos emmainoti Ieesous Pi-ekhristos ententaio (...) aksios aksios aksios (...).
text.en: Let come together, we the people who love our God Jesus Christ to honor the mother of God the virgin Saint Mary.
text.ar: فلنجتمع نحن الشعب المحب للإله يسوع المسيح لنكرم والدة الإله العذراء القديسة مريم.

section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

section.en: A Crown of gold (Oo-eklom, Eklil), Ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲗⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ
section.path: Feasts › Saints Feasts › General Glorification (Tamgeed of St.Mary)

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲗⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲱⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲅⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲁ̀ⲫⲉ (Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ) Ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ:
text.cop_lat: ou-eklom enoni emmargharitees e-ehree ejen etafe (Mari-a tiparthenos) Je ameen ameen ameen:
text.en: a crown of diamonds on the head of the Virgin Mary. Say amen, amen, amen.
text.ar: والدة الإله القديسة مريم.أمين أمين أمين ، اللليلويا الليلويا ،

text.cop: Ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ Ⲁ̅ⲗ̅ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
text.cop_lat: Alleelouia Alleelouia pi-oou fa Pennoti pe.
text.en: Allelulia, Allelulia. Glory be to our God.
